description: Implementation of the BackoffEntry class managing exponential backoff logic for network requests, including delay calculations, request rejection timing, and discard conditions.

classes.name: BackoffEntry
classes.description: Manages exponential backoff timing for network request retries, including delay calculation, request rejection, and discard logic.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::InformOfRequest
methods.description: Updates backoff state based on request success or failure, adjusting delay and failure count.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if current time is before the release time, indicating request should be rejected.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::GetTimeUntilRelease
methods.description: Returns the remaining time until the backoff release time.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::SetCustomReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets a custom release time for backoff.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::CanDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the backoff entry can be discarded based on its lifetime and failure count.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::Reset
methods.description: Resets the backoff state, including failure count and release time.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::GetTimeTicksNow
methods.description: Returns current time in ticks, using provided clock or system clock.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::CalculateReleaseTime
methods.description: Calculates the next release time based on failure count, delay policy, and jitter.

methods.name: BackoffEntry::BackoffDurationToReleaseTime
methods.description: Converts a backoff duration into a release time, considering maximum backoff constraints.
